definitions.gloss: dispersal; scattering; separation of family members
definitions.explanation: The scattering or forced separation of people, especially family members, due to war, disaster, or other circumstances. Often carries a tragic or sorrowful connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離散|りさん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The family was separated by war.

examples.japanese: {離散|りさん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何十年|なんじゅうねん}→何十年：30624_nanjuunen⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: A separated family achieved a reunion after decades.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内戦|ないせん}→内戦：19875_naisen⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離散|りさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{余儀|よぎ}なく→余儀なく：28255_yoginaku⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}れなく→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The civil war forced many people into dispersal, unable to return to their homeland.

notes:
USAGE:
{離散|りさん} most commonly appears in the phrase {離散|りさん}⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ (separated family), referring to families torn apart by war or political division. It carries a strong emotional weight and is frequently used in news and historical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {離散|りさん}⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ (separated/dispersed family)
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{離散|りさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (a family is separated)
- {離散|りさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{余儀|よぎ}なく→余儀なく：28255_yoginaku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be forced into dispersal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {離散|りさん}: dispersal (of people, especially families; tragic connotation)
- ⟦{分散|ぶんさん}→分散：18624_bunsan⟧: dispersion (of things, resources; neutral/technical)
- {散|ち}り{散|ぢ}り: scattered in all directions (people or things)
